name: The Marketplace at the Enclave
demographics: The Marketplace at the Enclave serves the growing Eastvale community, which is characterized by young families and middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area attracts residents from the nearby 490-unit master-planned Enclave at Eastvale development, with demographics skewing toward families with children seeking convenient neighborhood services. Primary shoppers are typically aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000, drawn to the center's mix of essential services including pharmacy, banking, dining, and personal care. The center caters to daily needs shopping patterns with quick-stop convenience being a key driver for the local residential base.
description: The Marketplace at the Enclave is a well-positioned 94,000 square foot neighborhood shopping center located at the southwest corner of Schleisman Road and Archibald Avenue in Eastvale, California. Developed and managed by Lewis Retail Centers, this community-focused destination serves the rapidly growing residential areas of Eastvale, particularly the nearby 490-unit master-planned Enclave at Eastvale community. The center is anchored by trusted national brands including CVS Pharmacy, AutoZone, Starbucks, and Jack in the Box, providing essential services and convenient dining options for local residents. Beyond its anchor tenants, the center features a diverse mix of 16 retailers and service providers including Bank of America, Everbrook Academy of Eastvale, Vista Medical Group, DaVita Dialysis, and various dining options such as Juice It Up!, W Cafe, and Wabi Sabi. With additional offerings like Mes Amies Hair Salon, Hotworx Yoga, and foot massage services, The Marketplace at the Enclave has established itself as a one-stop destination for daily necessities, healthcare, wellness, and family services in the heart of Eastvale's growing community.
summary: The Marketplace at the Enclave is a 94,000 square foot neighborhood center in Eastvale, California, anchored by CVS, AutoZone, Starbucks, and Jack in the Box. Serving the nearby master-planned Enclave community, this 16-tenant center offers a convenient mix of retail, dining, healthcare, and personal services for local families.
